scripts.predev: npm run build -w @filialhub/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @filialhub/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,cyan "npm run dev -w @filialhub/api" "npm run dev -w @filialhub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @filialhub/shared && npm run build -w @filialhub/api && npm run build -w @filialhub/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c red,cyan "npm run start -w @filialhub/api" "npm run start -w @filialhub/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @filialhub/shared && npm run dev -w @filialhub/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @filialhub/shared && npm run build -w @filialhub/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @filialhub/shared && npm run build -w @filialhub/web
